title: Highwayman
original_lyrics:
[chorus]
I was highwayman along the coach roads I did ride
with sword and pistol by my side
Many young maid lost her baubles to my trade.
Many soldier lost his lifeblood on my blade.
The bastards hung me in the spring of '25

[bridge]
I was sailor; I was born upon the tide
with the sea I did abide
I sailed schooner round the horn of Mexico
I went aloft to 'furl the mainsail in 'blow
and when the yards broke off they said that I got killed

[bridge]
I was dam builder across the river deep and wide
where steel and water did collide
place called Boulder on the wide Colorado
I slipped and fell into the wet concrete below
They buried me in that great tomb that knows no sound

[bridge]
I'll always be around and around and around and around and around
I fly starship across the universe divide
and when I reach the other side
I'll find place to rest my spirit if I can
Perhaps I may become highwayman again
or I may simply be single drop of rain

[bridge]
and I'll be back again and again and again and again and again
